prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a sideswipe while changing lanes in Sugar Land, Texas, and has shoulder injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1022; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This call is being recorded for claim processing. Can you confirm you're comfortable continuing?

A: Yes, that's fine.

Q: Please describe where you were when the collision happened.

A: I was driving on the main road in Sugar Land, Texas, heading toward the shopping center. It was a weekday afternoon and traffic was moderate.

Q: What were you doing right before the impact?

A: I was moving from the left lane into the right lane because I needed to make a turn at the next exit. I checked my mirror and glanced over my shoulder, and I thought the lane was clear.

Q: What happened next?

A: The other vehicle was in my blind spot. It came alongside me and we sideswiped each other. I felt a jolt, and my car drifted a bit before I got it under control.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the contact?

A: Not clearly. I saw something gray in the corner of my eye just as I started to move over, but I didn't process it in time.

Q: Were you hurt?

A: Yes. My right shoulder hit the door frame and I've had pain since then. I went to urgent care that evening and they told me it looked like a strain, possibly a partial tear. I've been icing it and taking medication.

Q: Are you currently receiving any treatment?

A: I have a follow-up with an orthopedic clinic next week. My arm still feels weak when I lift anything overhead.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add about the collision?

A: Only that I'm sorry for any damage to the other car. I just want to get everything sorted out.

Q: Thank you. We'll follow up in writing with next steps.

A: Thank you.
